open_points.subject: first-administrator bootstrap audit
open_points.text: State 0 R0-07 says the bootstrap command is “never printed, logged or audited,” while State 1 M36 says it “writes one `staff.create` record with actor kind `system`.”
open_points.question: Does successful creation of the first administrator create an AuditRecord?
options: Create no audit record, as required by R0-07.
Create one system-authored `staff.create` AuditRecord, as required by M36.
open_points.default_guess: Create no audit record because R0-07 is the explicit product decision governing the bootstrap command.

witness.initial: A new deployment has no StaffAccount or AuditRecord.
events: The host operator runs the local bootstrap command with an email and password.
The command successfully creates the first active administrator.
outcomes: No AuditRecord is created; only the normalized email appears in the success message.
A `staff.create` AuditRecord is created with actor kind `system`, no actor or project, and the new `staff_id`.
witness.observer: A host operator or auditor querying the audit history sees either zero or one bootstrap audit entry.
